children.text: Participants
Superk: Neeraj, Siddharth Mutyala, Harsha, Sarat Chandra
ThinkByte: Pavan, Harsha Thota, Satish Chitturi
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on setting up and improving Google Ads and WhatsApp campaigns, lead management, and addressing process inefficiencies.
Main issues discussed: access to ad platforms, low response rates, lead assignment problems, and integration challenges with Superphone.
Follow-up actions: enhance training for agents, adjust campaign strategies, improve lead assignment accuracy, and integrate platforms for better tracking.
Decisions included starting Google Ads with a defined budget, refining WhatsApp campaign strategies, and optimizing lead management processes.
Google Ads Campaign
Decisions: Mahesh Patil executing campaigns, demonstrating creation strategies.
Initiate Google Ads campaigns with initial budget of 500,000 rupees to boost lead generation and engagement.
Access needed Facebook Ad Manager Mahesh Patil, essential setting up campaigns.
Use mix high-intent keywords, negative keywords, optimize performance, improve lead quality.
Lead Management and Assignment
Incorrect lead assignment due to issues with Superphone's auto-allotment feature, leading to missed follow-ups.
Address inefficiencies in lead assignment and follow-up processes to enhance conversion rates and ensure proper handling.
Decisions: Improve agent training on tool usage; ensure leads marked correctly for follow-up.
Agents face challenges filtering tasks, leads, impacting response times, accuracy.
Implement process improvements for timely assignment, follow-up, using direct call buttons, better landing page integration.
WhatsApp Campaigns
Challenges in integrating WhatsApp data with Superphone, leading to manual assignment of responses.
Experiment with various message templates, images to improve lead engagement, response rates.
Response rate lower than expected, around 1%, compared to target 5%.
Decisions: Test new message templates, including listicles, and consider using images to improve engagement.
Explore using multiple touchpoints, drip campaigns engage leads better.
Documentation and Process Improvement
Manual processes causing delays, potential errors in lead follow-up, assignment.
Decisions: Regularly audit processes for continual improvement, ensure alignment with best practices.
Develop and implement standardized processes for systematic lead handling, conversion optimization.
Document processes for consistent application, serve as training resource for new agents.
Lack of standardized processes leading to inconsistencies in lead handling, response tracking.
Communication and Coordination
Lack of integration affecting tracking, status changes of leads, hindering communication effectiveness.
Enhance coordination with Superphone and internal teams to address tool-related challenges, improve campaign execution.
Decisions: Collaborate with Superphone, internal teams for better tool integration, ensure alignment on expectations, processes.
Develop consistent communication strategies, including regular updates, feedback loops.
Action Items
Siddharth Mutyala
The team will seek Superphone's assistance to identify the team's needs and align them with expectations.
Harsha Thota
Follow up with the team to ensure they understand and address the 11 Whatsapp responses from today's backscamp.
Send the daily data for the next few days at least.
Sent around 1,000 messages to the G1 group today, using a longer template without images, which had not been tried before.
Update the keyword list and aim to proceed with the task today.
Send the Wix capture landing page link to the group.
Pain Point
Currently, Whatsapp responding leads are manually reassigned to an agent.
Only 16 responses received out of 1,000 messages sent, including 30 Whatsapp messages.
The response rate of 27 out of 1,000 messages is not great, indicating a need to improve outreach strategies.
Challenges have been identified in filtering calls and checking pending tasks efficiently.
People were not answering calls yesterday, indicating a need for deeper understanding and potential challenges in communication.
Difficulty setting up a Whatsapp number for multiple profiles under the meta business account launch.
Unable to trigger action due to being blocked as spam.
Lack of engagement and responses from participants in the group experiments.
The team is concerned about missing leads due to potential busyness of team members.
Lack of sufficient information provided by leads during calls is hindering effective communication.
Leads are being incorrectly assigned by someone in the Superphone team, rather than being auto-assigned.
The challenge is ensuring that information is collected from inbound leads, regardless of the level of granularity allowed for data collection.
Incorrect assignment of leads due to incomplete local district information could lead to persistent problems.
When replying to a Whatsapp chat, the number of the person replying is not properly shown, causing confusion and requiring others to check the contacts to identify the person.
Difficulty in filtering leads, leading to challenges in individual lead identification and message management.
